name: Publish video
description: Publishes a video to TikTok by pulling it from a public URL. TikTok downloads the video from the provided URL and publishes it directly to the creator's profile. Publishing is asynchronous — after calling this action, poll TIKTOK_FETCH_PUBLISH_STATUS with the returned publish_id to check completion. For uploading video files instead of URLs, use TIKTOK_UPLOAD_VIDEO.

caption.title: Caption
caption.description: Optional caption/title text for the video post. Maximum length: 2200 UTF-16 characters.

is_aigc.title: Is Aigc
is_aigc.description: Set true to label the video as AI-generated content.

video_url.title: Video Url
video_url.description: A publicly accessible URL of the video to publish. TikTok will pull the video from this URL. Must be HTTP/HTTPS. The video will be downloaded by TikTok's servers, so ensure the URL is accessible and not behind authentication.

disable_duet.title: Disable Duet
disable_duet.description: Whether to disable duets on the video.

privacy_level.title: Privacy Level
privacy_level.description: Privacy level selected by the user for the published video. Must be one drawn from the account's creator_info/query options. For unaudited apps only SELF_ONLY is permitted.

disable_stitch.title: Disable Stitch
disable_stitch.description: Whether to disable stitches on the video.

disable_comment.title: Disable Comment
disable_comment.description: Whether to disable comments on the video.

brand_content_toggle.title: Brand Content Toggle
brand_content_toggle.description: Set true if the content is a paid partnership promoting a third-party business.

brand_organic_toggle.title: Brand Organic Toggle
brand_organic_toggle.description: Set true if the content promotes the creator's own business.

video_cover_timestamp_ms.title: Video Cover Timestamp Ms
video_cover_timestamp_ms.description: Timestamp in milliseconds to use as video cover/thumbnail.

publish_id.title: Publish Id
publish_id.description: Identifier to track this posting action. Use with TIKTOK_FETCH_PUBLISH_STATUS to check processing status. Maximum length: 64 characters.

code.title: Code
code.description: Error code. Returns 'ok' for successful requests, or a specific error code for failures.

log_id.title: Log Id
log_id.description: Unique log identifier for debugging and support.

message.title: Message
message.description: Human-readable error message. Empty string for successful requests.

data.title: Data
data.description: Contains publish_id when successful. Omitted when request fails.

error.title: Error
error.description: Error information and request metadata. When successful, error.code is 'ok'.

error.title: Error
error.description: Error if any occurred during the execution of the action

successful.title: Successful
successful.description: Whether or not the action execution was successful or not
